title: Sum over every path that spells the label
brief: Collapse frame-by-frame paths into transcripts, list every path that spells a target, and compute the CTC loss by brute force on tiny inputs.
hints: collapse: walk the path once, keep a symbol when it differs from the previous frame's symbol and is not the blank. Merge first, then drop blanks.
path_log_prob: log_probs[np.arange(T), path] picks one entry per frame, and a product of probabilities is a sum of log probabilities.
paths_for: itertools.product(range(C), repeat=T) yields every path; keep the ones whose collapse equals the target.
ctc_loss_brute_force: np.logaddexp.reduce over the paths' log probabilities, negated. An empty list of paths gives an infinite loss.
min_frames: one frame per label, plus one extra for every pair of equal neighbors in the target.
